verdict.rationale: Bruno AI explicitly supports generating test assertions: users open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, describe what to assert, and Bruno generates reviewable test code; it can also generate whole collections with tests from backend source code. missing for 10: no evidence of generating tests directly from an OpenAPI/API spec import (only from source code or manual description), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this AI test-generation feature's quality.
